I ran `/code-conventions --review-pr` on `0056b6d5c...HEAD` (one commit, d10e51510, six files). This PR moves the shared CI jobs out of `ci.yml` into a new reusable workflow, `_ci-node.yml`, and adds `pull-request.yml` to run them on pull requests. I found one real error: two guides now name workflow files that don't exist. The other findings are small.

I went through all rules in `rules.json`, and none of them needed a deeper lookup. I wrote the checklist to the scratchpad because its default location is gitignored under `docs/`, and I left tracked files alone. The rules that applied were CHANGE-01, CHANGE-02, CHANGE-03, PR-01, PR-02, CONFIG-05, SEC-02 and STYLE-01. The rest are about application code, which this diff doesn't touch.

## Findings

**1. The guides name `staging.yml` and `production.yml`, which don't exist (PR-02, medium)**
- `docs/agents/testing.md:36` says `_ci-node.yml` is "called by `pull-request.yml`, `staging.yml` and `production.yml`".
- `docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md:166` says "the build and deploy jobs live in `staging.yml` and `production.yml`".
- Only `_ci-node.yml`, `architecture-check.yml`, `ci.yml`, `claude-code-review.yml`, `linear-release.yml` and `pull-request.yml` exist. The build and deploy jobs are still in `ci.yml` (`ci.yml:39`, `:79`, `:126`), which is also the other caller of `_ci-node.yml`.
- **Fix:** replace both mentions with `ci.yml`.

**2. A half-finished comment is left at the end of `_ci-node.yml` (STYLE-01, low)**
- `.github/workflows/_ci-node.yml:276-277` is a leftover from the move: "Production runs on arm64 only, so we build a single-arch image. We run on an" breaks off mid-sentence, and no job follows it.
- The full comment used to sit above `docker-publish-staging` and is now missing there (`ci.yml:39`). That matters because `src/modules/billing/README.md:192` still sends readers to `ci.yml` for the arm64 explanation.
- **Fix:** delete it from `_ci-node.yml` and put the full two-line comment back above `ci.yml:39`.

**3. `secrets: inherit` gives the test jobs every repository secret (SEC-02, low)**
- `.github/workflows/pull-request.yml:30` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml:37` use it. That hands the Docker Hub credentials (`DOCKER_USER`, `DOCKER_PASSWORD`) and the autodeploy secrets (`AUTODEPLOY_URL`, `AUTODEPLOY_TOKEN`) to jobs that only need `SAFE_CONFIG_BASE_URI` (`_ci-node.yml:175`, `:248`). The token GitHub provides to every job (`GITHUB_TOKEN`) is available anyway.
- The old single `ci.yml` had the same reach, so nothing got worse. But the move was a free chance to narrow it.
- **Fix:** declare `secrets: SAFE_CONFIG_BASE_URI: { required: false }` under `workflow_call` and pass only that.

**4. New inputs that no caller uses (PR-01 / CHANGE-01, low)**
- `.github/workflows/_ci-node.yml:17-29` adds `node_version`, `python_version` and `ref`. Neither caller passes any of them (`pull-request.yml:28-30`, `ci.yml:35-37`), and `ref` is threaded into every checkout.
- Making the Node version an input also leaves the `# Krypton` comment (`_ci-node.yml:82`, `:100`) promising something the value no longer guarantees.
- **Fix:** hard-code the versions as the old `ci.yml` did, and add inputs when a caller needs them.

**5. Deploy gating quietly got stricter (CHANGE-03, low)**
- Before, `docker-publish-staging` and `docker-publish-release` waited only on `biome` and `tests-finish` (old `ci.yml:275`, `:312`). Now they wait on the whole `ci` call (`ci.yml:44`, `:81`), so a failing `license-headers` or `env-validation` job also blocks a staging deploy or a release image.
- That's probably better, but the commit body calls the jobs "unchanged in substance" and doesn't mention it.
- **Fix:** say so in the PR's Summary.

**6. Commit subject starts with a capital letter (commits-and-prs.md rule, nit)**
- The subject is `ci: Extract the quality gate into a reusable workflow`. `docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md:13` asks for an imperative description starting in lowercase.
- Because `main` is squash-merged, only the PR title ends up in history.
- **Fix:** make sure the PR title reads `ci: extract the quality gate into a reusable workflow`.

## Checked and fine
- **Required checks:** the checks get renamed to `ci / <job>`. The commit body says branch protection must be renamed, and there's a comment at `_ci-node.yml:9-11`. It still has to be done when this merges.
- **PR concurrency:** the cancel-superseded-runs behaviour for PRs moved to `pull-request.yml:23-25` correctly.
- **Pinned actions:** every action is still pinned to a SHA, and none of the versions changed.
- **License headers:** all six changed files have their SPDX header.
- **Env files:** no environment variables or `.env.sample*` files changed.
